Package com.csse3200.game.perks

Class PerkService

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.perks.PerkService
public final class PerkService extends Object
Central registry and progress tracker for every Perk in the game. Any gameplay system - existing or future - reports progress toward a milestone with a single call:

PerkService.recordEvent("dashUsed", 1);

Adding a new perk tied to an EXISTING event key needs zero changes anywhere else - just a new entry in PerkDefinitions. Adding a perk for a brand-new milestone needs one new recordEvent(...) call at the point that milestone happens (e.g. inside the wall-jump code, once it exists), plus a new PerkDefinitions entry - nothing about this class changes either way.

Unlocked/in-progress state persists forever via Preferences (achievement-style), the same pattern PauseMenuDisplay already uses for audio settings.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public static void register(Perk perk)
      Registers a perk definition and loads any previously-saved progress for it. Call once per perk (see PerkDefinitions.registerAll()) before any recordEvent(...) calls for it will have any effect. Safe to call again for the same id - re-registering just reloads saved state, it doesn't duplicate the perk.

    • recordEvent

      public static void recordEvent(String eventKey, int amount)
      Reports progress toward every registered perk listening for this event key. Safe to call for a key with no matching perks - it's simply a no-op, so gameplay code never needs to check whether a perk exists before calling this.
